id: \bI hate restocking the shelves. Why is there so much to stock? We don't even carry that much.
en: \bI hate restocking the shelves. Why is there so much to stock? We don't even carry that much.
it: \bOdio rifornire gli scaffali. Perché c'è così tanta roba da sistemare? Non è che vendiamo poi tanto.

id: \bI meant to buy a Sun Stone. I think they messed up my order.
en: \bI meant to buy a Sun Stone. I think they messed up my order.
it: \bVolevo comprare una Pietrasolare. Credo che abbiano sbagliato il mio ordine.

id: \bHey, why don't you take it off my hands? Kids like this kind of stuff.
en: \bHey, why don't you take it off my hands? Kids like this kind of stuff.
it: \bEhi, perché non te la prendi tu? Ai ragazzini piace questa roba.

id: \bWait, now I can't get my money back...
en: \bWait, now I can't get my money back...
it: \bAspetta, adesso non posso più farmi ridare i soldi...

en: \sign[signskin]Express yourself with gifts!  4F: Wise Man Gifts
